experiment: PSMD3 binds HER2 protein; PSMD3 knockdown increases HER2 ubiquitination and loss, cuts proliferation and colony formation, and induces apoptosis; high PSMD3 tracks with HER2, tumor size, stage and shorter survival (strongest in HER2+)
model: Breast cancer cell lines, human breast tumor tissue, Oncomine and TCGA
title: Proteasome 26S Subunit, non-ATPase 3 (PSMD3) Regulates Breast Cancer by Stabilizing HER2 from Degradation
drugs_named: none (paper proposes PSMD3 as a new target)

experiment: Co-silencing PSMD3 with other 17q12 amplicon genes (STARD3, GRB7, PGAP3) and HER2 adds to the loss of cell viability
title: The HER2 amplicon includes several genes required for the growth and survival of HER2 positive breast cancer cells

experiment: Carfilzomib and bortezomib stabilize the phosphatase BDP1, lowering HER2 phosphorylation and PI3K/AKT signaling and blocking ER-alpha; they kill lapatinib- and endocrine-resistant HER2+/ER+ cells. PSMD3 is not tested by name.
model: HER2+/ER+ breast cancer cell lines, including resistant lines
title: Proteasome inhibitors prevent bi-directional HER2/estrogen-receptor cross-talk leading to cell death in endocrine and lapatinib-resistant HER2+/ER+ breast cancer cells
drug_mechanism_on_gene: indirect: inhibit the 26S proteasome core, not PSMD3 itself

experiment: PSMD1 and PSMD3 mRNA and protein are higher in many cancers than in normal tissue and are linked to survival; proposed as therapy targets. Approved proteasome drugs are discussed.
model: Pan-cancer TCGA and CPTAC data (earlier knockdown work was in CML cells)
title: 26S Proteasome Non-ATPase Regulatory Subunits 1 (PSMD1) and 3 (PSMD3) as Putative Targets for Cancer Prognosis and Therapy
drug_mechanism_on_gene: indirect: inhibit the 26S proteasome (approved for myeloma and lymphoma)
